title: VMF chosen machines
description: MACHINE-PICK-1. The machines a person chose for this migration, saved beside the reviewed assessment (machine-choices.json) by Set-VmfMachineChoice, in the first step of the migrate flow. Only these machines get a target and only these are planned; every other machine stays in the assessment and its report. A machine is chosen only when the target options give it a supported series. Bound to the assessment that was reviewed and to the target options the list was drawn from. An assessment with saved targets and no machine-choices.json (made before this document existed) counts every machine with a saved target as chosen.

assessmentHash.description: The hash of the assessment the target options were made from - the one the review approval binds. New-VmfPlan refuses a list saved against a different scan.

adviceVersion.description: The document version of target-advice.json the list was drawn from (PLANVER-2: Get-VmfDocumentVersion over the stored text, issued by the service). A save quoting another version is refused with 409.

identity.description: The signed-in user, from the sign-in and never from the request.

machines.description: The vmId of each chosen machine, as the assessment spells it.
